messages:
patrick: FYI — Acme Labs (acct acct_87f3a9b) says their 14-day trial credits expired in the middle of our DB migration window. They were running a large data import and started getting 5xxs around 2024-10-12T02:13:00Z. Auto-extension didn't trigger. Customer asking for manual reinstatement of ~18k token equivalent.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the account id, the exact error they saw, and any request ids? I can start the appeals flow.

patrick: pasted above acct_87f3a9b. Customer sent this snippet from their logs:
```
2024-10-12T02:13:04Z ERROR request_id=01F3X9 x-request-id=01A4Z2 502 Bad Gateway 
POST /v1/generate  body_size=4123 status=502 lat_ms=1203
{"error":"internal_service_error", "message":"upstream gateway failed"}
```
They also included our API response header: `x-request-id: 01A4Z2` and a curl trace: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-***\"`

maria: That matches the migration window in our infra notes (db-migrate-2024-10-12). Jamal / Lee, can you confirm whether the auto-credit-job would have been blocked by the migration?

lee: Confirming — during the migration we briefly held a write lock on the grants table and our webhook retries for account webhooks got 504/502 from the control plane. The auto-grant worker retries but there was a race condition: if the trial expiry cron ran while the webhook failed, the extension hook didn't mark the account as extended.

lee: Repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate failure window
export ACCOUNT=acct_87f3a9b
# write lock applied to grants table
# run expiry cron -> it marks expired
# meanwhile webhook to billing control plane returns 502
# auto-grant worker retries but loses the idempotency key
```

jamal: From policy: we can approve full reinstatement for credits lost during a Redwood-side outage if customer was blocked from productive use. Please attach evidence of the 5xx window + request ids. I'm going to kick off a manual grant request. @billing-bot please queue manual trial grant for acct_87f3a9b.

billing-bot: Manual grant request received. Grant: +18000 trial_tokens (equiv). Ticket created: CS-2026-4397. ETA: 30 minutes. Owner: jamal.

patrick: Customer replied with their account logs and the two x-request-ids (01A4Z2, 01A4Z7). They said they were able to resume after 02:45Z but lost ~40 minutes of import time.

maria: Jamal — can you confirm when the grant goes through and what we tell the customer about expiration extension window? Policy allows us to extend remaining trial to 30 days after grant.

jamal: Grant applied at 1845680000 (internal). I set an override to give them 30 days from now. Logged note on account: "Manual credit granted for outage during db-migrate-2024-10-12; ticket CS-2026-4397."

patrick: Customer confirmed they now see the credits and import resumed. They asked whether this will require any further action on their side — I told them no.

maria: Action items: 1) Confirm postmortem link for migration and include customer impact. 2) Add retry/idempotency fix to auto-grant worker. 3) Update KB article about trial expiration during incidents.

lee: Created INF-2456: "Make auto-grant worker idempotent & resilient to webhook failures" and assigned to eng-runtime. ETA sprint+1.

maria: Closing notes to add to the ticket: manual +18000 trial tokens applied, expiration extended 30 days, explanation & apology sent to customer, engineering issue INF-2456 filed. Customer happy and import completed. :white_check_mark:

patrick: Thanks all. I'll close out with the customer and paste the confirmation.

maria: Marking resolved in Slack thread and CS ticket. If anything else pops up reopen.

billing-bot: Ticket CS-2026-4397 updated: status=resolved.
